summary_en.result: The approach achieves fast convergence for a 30-parameter random field inference using only about 1000 model evaluations.

summary_en.validation: Comparison with finite element analysis-based topology optimization in terms of displacement prediction accuracy and optimization results.

summary_en.result: The approach achieves real-time goal-oriented UQ and is validated on medical tomography and nonlinear hydraulic tomography.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation cases in medical imaging and hydrology demonstrate the method's accuracy and efficiency.

title: Multi-fidelity prediction of fluid flow and temperature field based on transfer learning using Fourier Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真傅里叶神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决高保真数据稀缺问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on fluid flow and temperature prediction in marine/aerospace engineering, not on solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真数据获取成本高，需利用低保真数据辅助建模。
summary_zh.method: 基于傅里叶神经算子和迁移学习，联合低保真与高保真数据。
summary_zh.result: 预测精度达99%，优于纯高保真模型。
summary_zh.validation: 三个典型流体与温度场问题数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity data is expensive to obtain, motivating the use of abundant low-fidelity data to improve prediction accuracy.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity Fourier Neural Operator with transfer learning integrates low- and high-fidelity data for resolution-invariant prediction.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves 99% accuracy on three benchmark fluid and temperature prediction problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on fluid flow and temperature fields demonstrate effectiveness compared to high-fidelity-only models.

title: Effect of hirtisation on the roughness and fatigue performance of porous titanium lattice structures
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了多孔钛合金点阵结构的表面粗糙度与疲劳性能，与用户关于AM生物医用植入物的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report osseointegration or in vivo validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高增材制造多孔钛点阵的疲劳性能，克服表面缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 采用Hirtisation后处理降低点阵支柱表面粗糙度，并测试疲劳性能。
summary_zh.result: 处理后疲劳强度提升80%，刚度匹配的疲劳强度比提高90%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态力学归一化对比疲劳性能，评估处理均匀性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome fatigue limitations of additively manufactured porous titanium lattices caused by surface defects such as semi-fused particles.
summary_en.method: Hirtisation post-processing was applied to Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures to reduce strut surface roughness, followed by fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Normalized high-cycle fatigue strength increased by 80% after hirtisation, and the fatigue strength-to-stiffness ratio improved by 90%.
summary_en.validation: Validation included surface roughness measurement, quasi-static mechanical normalization, and fatigue testing with comparison to untreated samples.

title: Learning solution of nonlinear constitutive material models using physics-informed neural networks: COMM-PINN
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对非线性本构模型的求解效率问题，提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的替代方法，可显著降低计算成本，且方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的材料建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, patient-specific geometry, or uncertainty quantification in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统非线性本构模型求解需反复牛顿迭代，计算成本高
summary_zh.method: 用物理信息神经网络直接学习本构关系，满足热力学约束
summary_zh.result: 训练后的网络可即时预测材料状态，与经典方法结果一致且计算更快
summary_zh.validation: 通过von Mises塑性模型和界面损伤模型数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational burden of iterative Newton solvers in nonlinear constitutive material models.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (COMM-PINN) is trained to directly output free energy, stress, and internal variables while satisfying thermodynamic constraints.
summary_en.result: The trained network achieves perfect agreement with classical solutions and significantly reduces implementation effort and computing time.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on von Mises plasticity with nonlinear hardening and 3D interface damage models.

title: Robust Deep Learning Framework for Constitutive-Relation Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度学习框架可用于替代昂贵的有限元模拟，且包含不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the surrogate model to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统本构模型难以处理高维复杂加载历史，需要鲁棒的替代方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出编码器-解码器深度学习框架，将高维输入映射到低维隐空间再预测应力。
summary_zh.result: 多种架构在复杂应力-应变数据集上均达到RMSE低于1 MPa的优异测试结果。
summary_zh.validation: 在两种复杂应力-应变数据集上验证，并采用深度集成进行不确定性估计。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional constitutive models struggle with high-dimensional complex loading histories, necessitating a robust alternative.
summary_en.method: An encoder-decoder deep learning framework is proposed, where the encoder projects high-dimensional inputs to a low-dimensional latent space and the decoder predicts stress.
summary_en.result: Various architectures achieve excellent test results with RMSE below 1 MPa on complex stress-strain datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two complex stress-strain datasets with uncertainty estimation via deep ensembles.

title: Multilevel CNNs for Parametric PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层级CNN架构可高效求解高维参数化PDE，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond benchmark problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解高维参数化PDE，降低训练数据生成成本
summary_zh.method: 结合多层级求解器与CNN，设计可逼近多重网格V循环的神经网络架构
summary_zh.result: 在100维随机电导率和随机cookie问题上超越现有深度学习方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过高维线性椭圆PDE基准问题验证，分析逼近误差与参数维度无关性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve high-dimensional parametric PDEs by reducing the cost of generating training data and training time.
summary_en.method: Proposes a multilevel CNN architecture that approximates multigrid V-cycles with logarithmic weight complexity in mesh resolution.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior performance on high-dimensional random conductivity and random cookie problems compared to state-of-the-art deep learning solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark parametric linear elliptic PDEs with theoretical analysis showing dimension-independent approximation bounds.

title: GPT-PINN: Generative Pre-Trained Physics-Informed Neural Networks toward non-intrusive Meta-learning of parametric PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了面向参数化PDE的生成式预训练PINN元学习框架，可直接应用于生物力学植入体设计的代理建模，提高多查询和实时仿真效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification or application to biomechanical implant design, nor does it address experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化PDE多查询和实时仿真中PINN的训练成本
summary_zh.method: 提出GPT-PINN，使用超简约元网络，每个隐藏神经元为预训练PINN，逐神经元增长学习参数依赖
summary_zh.result: 元网络能在整个参数域上高效准确地生成代理解
summary_zh.validation: 在1D和2D参数化PDE数值算例上验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the high training cost of PINNs in multi-query and real-time simulation settings for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: Propose GPT-PINN, a meta-learning framework with a hyper-reduced meta-network where each hidden neuron is a pre-trained PINN at adaptively selected parameter points, and the network grows neurons one by one to learn parametric dependence.
summary_en.result: The meta-network generates accurate surrogate solutions across the entire parameter domain efficiently with minimal additional training.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 1D and 2D parametric PDE benchmarks, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency over standard PINN.

summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩和微型CT进行力学和结构表征

summary_en.motivation: To design porous implants with stiffness matching bone to prevent stress shielding in bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Split-P TPMS lattice structures in Ti6Al4V were fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM).
summary_en.result: The lattices achieved mechanical properties comparable to cancellous bone with tunable stiffness and strength.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed via quasi-static compression tests and micro-CT morphological analysis.

why_not_core: This paper lacks fatigue testing and does not quantify surface roughness or as-built morphology, which are key for implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计含铜CoCr多孔支架以减轻应力屏蔽并促进早期骨长入。
summary_zh.method: 利用SLM制备三种单胞类型（OCT、FCC、HCP）的多孔支架，并系统研究孔径与单胞对压缩性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: OCT结构在促进骨矿化方面表现最佳，所有支架均具有良好的生物相容性和骨整合能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验和山羊体内植入12周验证骨长入效果。

summary_en.motivation: To design Cu-bearing CoCr porous scaffolds with reduced stress shielding and enhanced early bone ingrowth for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate scaffolds with three unit cell types (octahedron, face-centered cubic, hexahedron) and varying pore sizes, and their compressive properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: The octahedron scaffold showed the strongest ability to accelerate bone mineralization among the three types, while all scaffolds supported bone ingrowth after 12 weeks of goat implantation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro osteogenesis and angiogenesis assays were combined with in vivo goat implantation to validate biocompatibility and osseointegration.

title: A predictive machine learning model to optimize flow rates on an integrated microfluidic pumping system for peptide-based 3D bioprinting

why_not_core: The paper focuses on flow rate optimization for peptide bioinks, but does not address cell viability, post-printing analysis, or broader bioprinting workflow stages beyond pre-printing parameter tuning.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化肽基生物墨水的挤出流速，提高3D生物打印的可靠性和标准化。
summary_zh.method: 采用多输出回归机器学习模型，以生物墨水类型、浓度、缓冲液浓度和喷嘴尺寸为输入，预测最优流速。
summary_zh.result: 模型集成到TwinPrint软件中，自动推荐流速，提升了打印一致性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大量实验数据训练模型，并通过实际打印演示验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize extrusion flow rates of peptide bioinks for improved reliability and standardization in 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A multi-output regression machine learning model that predicts optimal flow rates using inputs such as bioink type, concentration, PBS concentration, and nozzle size.
summary_en.result: The model was integrated into the TwinPrint software to automatically suggest flow rates, enhancing print consistency.
summary_en.validation: The model was trained on experimental data from numerous bioprinting experiments and validated through practical printing demonstrations.

title: NSGA-PINN: A Multi-Objective Optimization Method for Physics-Informed Neural Network Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的NSGA-PINN框架直接解决了PINN训练中的多目标优化问题，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的约束处理与优化求解。
why_not_core: This paper does not include FEA validation, biomechanical context, or uncertainty quantification, and the method is only demonstrated on mathematical PDE benchmarks rather than engineering simulation problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中多目标损失平衡问题，避免陷入局部最优。
summary_zh.method: 采用NSGA-II算法结合梯度优化，处理多目标损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE/ODE问题中优于传统训练方法，包括反问题。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值PDE基准问题上验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of balancing multiple loss terms in physics-informed neural network training and escaping local minima.
summary_en.method: A non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is integrated with gradient-based optimizers to handle multi-objective loss functions in PINNs.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework outperforms standard training on several forward and inverse PDE problems, especially in the presence of noise.
summary_en.validation: Validated on canonical ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, including inverse problems with noisy data.

title: The optimal design of 3D-printed lattice bone plate by considering fracture healing mechanism.

why_not_core: Does not report fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration; focused on static mechanical strength and fracture healing simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 为减少骨板应力遮挡，基于骨折愈合理论优化设计晶格骨板。
summary_zh.method: 建立力学调控模型模拟组织分化，优化弹性模量，填充多孔微结构并通过有限元和实验验证。
summary_zh.result: 最佳弹性模量为38 GPa，晶格骨板满足强度要求并加速愈合。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元分析和机械测试。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding in bone plates, an optimal design method based on fracture healing theory is proposed for lattice bone plates.
summary_en.method: A mechanical regulation model with deviatoric strain simulates tissue differentiation; an optimization formulation maximizes healing rate by tuning elastic modulus, and microstructures with adjusted porosity achieve the target modulus, validated by FEA and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The optimal elastic modulus in the design domain is 38 GPa, and the manufactured lattice bone plates satisfy strength requirements for internal fixation implants.
summary_en.validation: Finite element analysis and experimental mechanical testing on 3D-printed specimens.

why_not_core: No fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统实心股骨植入物因泊松效应导致近端外侧应力屏蔽，引入负泊松比超材料以改善载荷传递。
summary_zh.method: 基于CT数据设计患者特异性植入物，在侧向嵌入2D和3D负泊松比超材料，通过LPBF制造并开展压缩实验和有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 超材料植入物使近端外侧骨应变分别增加7.1%和44.1%，骨重塑分析显示实心植入物骨吸收2.5%，超材料植入物骨沉积达7.7%。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元预测与压缩实验应变高度相关（R²=0.9821和0.9977）。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional solid femoral implants cause stress shielding in the proximal-lateral region due to positive Poisson's ratio; this study introduces auxetic metamaterials to mitigate load shielding and promote osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Patient-specific femoral implants were designed from CT data, with 2D (type-1) and 3D (type-2) auxetic metamaterials integrated into the lateral side; specimens were fabricated via metal additive manufacturing and tested under compression, alongside finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: Type-1 and type-2 meta-implants increased von Mises strain in the proximal-lateral region by 7.1% and 44.1% over the solid implant, and bone remodeling analysis showed 0.5% and 7.7% bone apposition, respectively, versus 2.5% resorption for the solid implant.
summary_en.validation: Experimental strains from compression testing correlated strongly with FE predictions (R² = 0.9821 and 0.9977).

title: On the Integration of Physics-Based Machine Learning with Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling Techniques
relevance_to_user: 该论文将力学模型嵌入高斯过程均值函数，提出一种物理启发的代理模型方法，可用于生物力学中的有限元代理建模，提高采样效率并提供不确定性量化。
why_not_core: While highly relevant to surrogate modeling, the paper does not address multi-objective optimization or explicit constraint handling, nor does it apply directly to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对黑箱模型在盲条件下表现差的问题，提出将力学模型嵌入GP均值函数，结合核函数处理物理误差。
summary_zh.method: 将力学模型嵌入GP均值，使用与物理模型梯度相关的核函数，并采用层次贝叶斯处理计算可扩展性。
summary_zh.result: 通过数值和实验例子验证了该方法在结构动力学反问题中的应用潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟和结构动力学实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve black-box model performance under blind conditions by incorporating physics knowledge into machine learning surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Embed a mechanics-based model into the mean function of a Gaussian Process and use a kernel function linked to the gradient of the physics model, with hierarchical Bayesian techniques for scalability.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated the method's potential in structural dynamics inverse problems through numerical and experimental examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes both numerical simulations and experimental tests on structural dynamics.

title: Approximating scaffold printability utilizing computational methods.

summary_en.method: A fuzzy inference system with four inputs (bioink concentration, flow rate, speed, temperature) and two outputs (linewidth variance and printability) was implemented.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters achieved high printability and precision for scaffolds with up to 30×10^6 cells/ml.

title: Uncertainty quantification for nonlinear solid mechanics using reduced order models with Gaussian process regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对非线性固体力学中的不确定性量化问题，提出了基于高斯过程回归的非侵入式降阶模型，与用户的高保真仿真替代模型方向高度相关。
